title.zh: 可认证张成空间外交互逆算子

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 explicit interaction residual supervision 与 out-of-span projection 捆绑为单一机制。最终识别假设改为：在已经由 LP/Farkas certificate 独立证明 stored-delta span 无法同时满足 repair 与 preservation 的样本上，rollback-derived interaction evidence 与强制 span-exit 是两个可独立操纵的因素；只有严格 2×2 交叉实验仍显示不可替代的因素或二者交互，才能获得机制归因。
changed_assumption.en: Explicit interaction-residual supervision and out-of-span projection are no longer bundled into one mechanism. The final identification assumption is that, on cases independently certified by an LP/Farkas witness to be unsatisfiable inside the stored-delta span, rollback-derived interaction evidence and mandatory span exit are separately manipulable factors; mechanistic attribution is allowed only for the factor or interaction that remains necessary in a strict 2x2 crossed test.

exact_mechanism.zh: 冻结 representation 与低秩 linear decision adapter，并对每个 failure composition 使用同一组预注册 repair/preservation probes 求 stored-delta-span 可行性；仅保留带 LP dual/Farkas infeasibility certificate 的 cases。对每个 certified case 固定执行完全相同的 single、pairwise、full rollback，并由这些 execution records 计算唯一 deterministic interaction residual R。随后训练四个容量完全匹配的 generator：Target-OFF/Projection-OFF、Target-ON/Projection-OFF、Target-OFF/Projection-ON、Target-ON/Projection-ON。四个 cell 都获得相同 atom summaries、constraints、rollback records、R 及其所有允许的 deterministic statistics；Target-ON 仅额外启用以 R 为目标的预注册 interaction-direction auxiliary loss，Target-OFF 禁用该 loss，但仍可把 R 作为输入特征；Projection-ON 将生成方向通过 frozen Q_perp=I-P_span 投影到 stored-delta span 的正交补，Projection-OFF 直接输出同维 unconstrained direction。四个 cell 使用相同 adapter rank、generator 参数量、calls、tokens、optimizer、minibatches、optimization steps 和 wall-clock-equivalent update budget。Target-ON/Projection-OFF 同时作为 unrestricted residual-conditioned generator：它可直接消费 rollback-derived residual 并具有完整监督，但不被强制离开 span。2×2 factorial contrasts 与该 unrestricted control 在训练前写入 identification contract。
exact_mechanism.en: Freeze the representation and low-rank linear decision adapter, solve the same preregistered repair/preservation feasibility problem inside the stored-delta span for every failing composition, and retain only cases carrying an LP-dual/Farkas infeasibility certificate. For every certified case, execute exactly the same single, pairwise, and full rollbacks and deterministically compute one interaction residual R from those execution records. Train four capacity-matched generators: Target-OFF/Projection-OFF, Target-ON/Projection-OFF, Target-OFF/Projection-ON, and Target-ON/Projection-ON. Every cell receives identical atom summaries, constraints, rollback records, R, and all permitted deterministic statistics derived from them. Target-ON only activates a preregistered interaction-direction auxiliary loss whose target is R; Target-OFF disables that loss while remaining free to consume R as an input feature. Projection-ON maps the generated direction through the frozen operator Q_perp=I-P_span, while Projection-OFF emits an unconstrained direction of the same dimensionality. All four cells have identical adapter rank, generator parameter count, calls, tokens, optimizer, minibatches, optimization steps, and wall-clock-equivalent update budget. Target-ON/Projection-OFF is also the unrestricted residual-conditioned generator: it may directly consume the rollback residual and receives the full supervision but is not forced outside the span. The 2x2 factorial contrasts and this unrestricted control are part of the preregistered identification contract.

learning_signal.zh: 所有条件共享完全相同的 certified training cases、rollback executions、interaction residual R、repair/preservation constraints 与 hidden-case sampling。唯一预注册监督操纵是是否对同一个 R 启用 explicit interaction-direction loss；关闭该 loss 不删除 R、rollback trace 或任何可确定计算的 residual statistic，因此不存在信息剥夺式 baseline。
learning_signal.en: All conditions share exactly the same certified training cases, rollback executions, interaction residual R, repair/preservation constraints, and hidden-case sampling. The only preregistered supervision intervention is whether the explicit interaction-direction loss against the same R is activated; disabling that loss does not remove R, rollback traces, or any deterministically computable residual statistic, eliminating information-deprived baselines.

independent_ground_truth.zh: certificate 只由冻结 adapter 参数空间中的线性 repair/preservation inequalities 产生；最终正确性由未用于 certificate、residual target 或训练的隐藏 execution tests 判定，包括目标行为恢复、保持行为不退化以及组合任务真实成功。certificate 与 truth 因而相互独立。
independent_ground_truth.en: The certificate is derived only from linear repair/preservation inequalities in the frozen adapter parameter space. Final correctness is determined by hidden execution tests never used for the certificate, residual target, or training, including target-behavior recovery, preservation of protected behavior, and true compositional task success. Certificate and truth are therefore independent.

simplest_baseline.zh: 最强简化方法是 Target-ON/Projection-OFF 的容量匹配 unrestricted conditional generator：它获得与 proposed cell 完全相同的 certified cases、atom summaries、constraints、single/pair/full rollbacks、interaction residual R、explicit residual-target supervision、adapter rank、参数量、calls、tokens、optimizer 和训练步数，但可以自由产生任意低秩 adapter patch，不执行 orthogonal-complement projection。另两个 crossed cells 分别检验 residual-target-only 与 projection-only 解释。
simplest_baseline.en: The strongest simplification is the capacity-matched Target-ON/Projection-OFF unrestricted conditional generator. It receives exactly the same certified cases, atom summaries, constraints, single/pair/full rollbacks, interaction residual R, explicit residual-target supervision, adapter rank, parameter count, calls, tokens, optimizer, and training steps as the proposed cell, but may emit any low-rank adapter patch without orthogonal-complement projection. The other crossed cells separately test residual-target-only and projection-only explanations.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在模型训练前冻结 certified-case list、2×2 design、hidden execution set 与 factorial contrasts。首先只在 Farkas-certified held-out compositions 上比较四个 cells，并报告 Target 主效应、Projection 主效应及交互；同时直接比较完整 Target-ON/Projection-ON 与 unrestricted Target-ON/Projection-OFF。若只有 projection contrast 在 residual supervision 等价时仍成立，则主张限定为 certified span-exit；若只有 target contrast 成立，则主张限定为 interaction supervision；若只有交互显著且两个单因素均不能复现，则只主张二者交互。所有归因必须同时在独立 hidden execution truth 上成立。
decisive_pilot.en: Before training, freeze the certified-case list, 2x2 design, hidden execution set, and factorial contrasts. Evaluate all four cells only on Farkas-certified held-out compositions, reporting the Target main effect, Projection main effect, and their interaction, while directly comparing full Target-ON/Projection-ON against unrestricted Target-ON/Projection-OFF. If only the projection contrast survives under equal residual supervision, the claim is restricted to certified span exit; if only the target contrast survives, it is restricted to interaction supervision; if only the interaction survives and neither single factor reproduces it, only the interaction is claimed. Every attribution must also hold on independent hidden execution truth.

stop_condition.zh: 若 unrestricted residual-conditioned generator 在 independently certified held-out cases 上复现完整方法，停止 out-of-span 机制主张；若 Target-OFF/Projection-ON 复现完整方法，停止 explicit interaction-target 主张；若 Target-ON/Projection-OFF 复现完整方法，停止 projection 主张；若四个条件均不能在 hidden execution truth 上稳定优于最简单等价方法，则终止该 idea，而不通过重新命名或增加组件继续修补。
stop_condition.en: If the unrestricted residual-conditioned generator reproduces the full method on independently certified held-out cases, stop the out-of-span mechanism claim. If Target-OFF/Projection-ON reproduces the full method, stop the explicit interaction-target claim; if Target-ON/Projection-OFF reproduces it, stop the projection claim. If no factorially isolated component or interaction yields a stable advantage on hidden execution truth over the simplest equivalent method, terminate the idea rather than adding or renaming components.

material_change.zh: v5.3 的实质变化不是增加新模块，而是把先前捆绑且 supervision 不等价的 comparison 改成数据、rollback、residual statistics、capacity 与 budget 全部等价的预注册 2×2 因果识别设计，并加入可直接消费 residual 的 unrestricted generator。因此最终新颖性只能落在被 factorial test 真正证明不可替代的 certified span-exit、interaction supervision 或二者交互上。
material_change.en: The material v5.3 change is not an added component but replacement of the previously bundled and supervision-unequal comparison with a preregistered 2x2 causal identification design equalized for data, rollbacks, residual statistics, capacity, and budget, plus an unrestricted generator that can directly consume the residual. Novelty can therefore be attributed only to certified span exit, interaction supervision, or their interaction if the factorial test shows that element to be indispensable.

title.zh: 编译器残差式契约编辑器

changed_assumption.zh: 残差编辑器的优势必须在 monolithic rewriter 获得完全相同的 residualized training examples、target traces、残差标注、成功/失败监督、verifier access、计算量与参数预算后仍存在；因此唯一允许保留的机制差异是输出对象被限制为 compiler 后 schema-underdetermined relational residual，而不是训练数据或监督更强。
changed_assumption.en: Any advantage of the residual editor must survive after the monolithic rewriter receives exactly the same residualized training examples, target traces, residual annotations, success/failure supervision, verifier access, compute, and parameter budget. The only permitted mechanistic difference is therefore the output object: post-compiler schema-underdetermined relational residuals versus an unrestricted complete target asset.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对每个 source/target schema pair 先运行共享 deterministic compiler C_schema 得到 M0。训练集固定为同一组 source-target asset pairs；对每一 pair 同时保存 source asset、target asset、M0、target execution traces、checker outcomes、成功/失败 labels，以及由 M0 与 target asset 按固定 canonical differencer 得到的 residual edit annotation delta_R。typed residual editor 只能生成白名单 dependency-edge、semantic-predicate 与 temporal-relation edits，并输出 Apply(M0,delta_R_hat)。容量匹配 monolithic rewriter 在训练时逐例获得完全相同的 source asset、target asset、M0、delta_R annotation、target traces、checker outcomes 和 labels，具有同维 matched auxiliary residual head 以消费同一 residual supervision，但主输出可自由生成完整 target asset；auxiliary head 在推理时丢弃。两者使用完全相同的 train/validation examples、calls、tokens、batch schedule、optimization steps、parameter budget、verifier V 和 checker-guided repair/rejection attempts。任何因完整输出序列更长造成的 token 差额通过预注册 padding/masked decoding budget 对齐，而不允许 residual editor 获得更多有效优化。
exact_mechanism.en: For every source/target schema pair, first run the shared deterministic compiler C_schema to obtain M0. Freeze one common training set of source-target asset pairs. For every pair, store the source asset, target asset, M0, target execution traces, checker outcomes, success/failure labels, and a residual-edit annotation delta_R produced from M0 and the target asset by a fixed canonical differencer. The typed residual editor may emit only whitelisted dependency-edge, semantic-predicate, and temporal-relation edits and returns Apply(M0, delta_R_hat). During training, the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter receives, example by example, the identical source asset, target asset, M0, delta_R annotation, target traces, checker outcomes, and labels, and contains an equally sized auxiliary residual head so that it consumes the same residual supervision while its primary output remains an unrestricted complete target asset; the auxiliary head is discarded at inference. Both methods use exactly the same train/validation examples, calls, tokens, batch schedule, optimization steps, parameter budget, verifier V, and checker-guided repair/rejection attempts. Any output-length token difference is equalized by a preregistered padded/masked decoding budget rather than granting the residual editor more effective optimization.

children.update_surface: persistent migrated memory-contract asset after deterministic schema compilation

learning_signal.zh: 两个模型逐样本共享相同 source-target pair、canonical delta_R、target execution traces、V 的 success/failure outcomes 与 checker feedback；训练次数、有效 token、梯度步数和参数规模严格对齐。delta_R 不再是 residual editor 独占的监督来源。
learning_signal.en: Both models share, example by example, the same source-target pair, canonical delta_R, target execution traces, verifier success/failure outcomes, and checker feedback, with strictly matched effective tokens, gradient steps, calls, and parameter count. Delta_R is no longer supervision available only to the residual editor.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 最终 truth 来自训练与 subset 构造均不可见的 hidden target executions、隐藏 relational assertions、handoff/temporal invariants 以及 joint model-and-harness swap 后的真实任务完成；训练时的 target traces、delta_R 和 verifier V 不包含这些 hidden assertions。
independent_ground_truth.en: Final truth comes from hidden target executions, hidden relational assertions, handoff/temporal invariants, and true task completion under joint model-and-harness swaps that are unavailable during training and subset construction. Training target traces, delta_R annotations, and verifier V do not contain these hidden assertions.

simplest_baseline.zh: checker-equalized、capacity-matched monolithic rewriter：使用与 residual editor 完全相同的 source-target asset pairs、M0、canonical residual annotations、target traces、success/failure labels、schemas、V、repair attempts、calls、tokens、参数量和 optimization steps，但允许直接输出任意完整 target asset，而不受 residual whitelist 或 Apply(M0,·) 分解限制。
simplest_baseline.en: A checker-equalized, capacity-matched monolithic rewriter trained on exactly the same source-target asset pairs, M0 values, canonical residual annotations, target traces, success/failure labels, schemas, verifier V, repair attempts, calls, tokens, parameter count, and optimization steps as the residual editor, while remaining free to emit any complete target asset without the residual whitelist or Apply(M0,·) decomposition.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在查看任何模型比较结果之前，使用 deterministic compiler 与 gold target asset 预注册 residual-required subset：M0 必须已经通过 schema/type/reference checker，但相对于 gold target 的 canonical diff 至少包含一个白名单 relational residual，且该 residual 对预注册 target execution assertion 是必要的；subset membership 完全由 compiler、gold asset 与预定义 assertion procedure 决定，与任一 learned model 输出无关。随后在相同 residual-required held-out cases 上比较 residual editor 与 monolithic rewriter，并额外执行 joint unseen-model × unseen-harness swap。主结论只取 hidden execution success、关系正确率与 preservation failure；完整 held-out set 同时作为防止 subset-only overfitting 的次级报告。
decisive_pilot.en: Before inspecting any model-comparison result, preregister the residual-required subset using only the deterministic compiler and gold target assets: M0 must already pass the schema/type/reference checker, its canonical difference from the gold target must contain at least one whitelisted relational residual, and that residual must be necessary for a preregistered target-execution assertion. Subset membership is therefore determined entirely by the compiler, gold asset, and predefined assertion procedure, never by either learned model's output. Compare the residual editor and monolithic rewriter on the identical held-out residual-required cases and additionally perform a joint unseen-model x unseen-harness swap. Primary outcomes are hidden execution success, relational correctness, and preservation failure; the complete held-out set is reported secondarily to prevent subset-only overfitting.

stop_condition.zh: 若在预注册 residual-required subset 上，获得完全相同数据、delta_R supervision、target traces、verifier、calls、tokens、optimization steps 和参数预算的 monolithic rewriter 匹配 residual editor 的 hidden execution 与 swap transfer，则停止“post-compiler residual object 带来额外迁移优势”的主张。若优势只出现在未预注册或由模型结果选择的 subset，也停止该主张。
stop_condition.en: If the monolithic rewriter, after receiving identical data, delta_R supervision, target traces, verifier access, calls, tokens, optimization steps, and parameter budget, matches the residual editor on hidden execution and swap transfer within the preregistered residual-required subset, stop the claim that the post-compiler residual object adds transfer value. Also stop the claim if the advantage appears only on a subset selected after observing model results.

material_change.zh: v5.3 明确消除了最后的数据/监督不等价：monolithic control 现在逐样本获得 residual editor 的全部 residualized pairs、target traces 和 residual supervision，并在 calls、tokens、优化与参数上完全匹配；同时 residual-required subset 在模型比较前由 deterministic procedure 冻结。因此剩余差异仅是 learned output surface 的 factorization。
material_change.en: v5.3 removes the final data/supervision inequivalence: the monolithic control now receives, example by example, all residualized pairs, target traces, and residual supervision available to the residual editor, with fully matched calls, tokens, optimization, and parameters. The residual-required subset is also frozen by a deterministic procedure before model comparison. The only remaining difference is factorization of the learned output surface.

title.zh: 滤波式纵向评价器状态外推

changed_assumption.zh: chronological-state 主张不能由仍含 absolute timestamp 的简单顺序 shuffle 来识别。最终假设要求：只有在一个保持 fingerprint 与 interval 各自边际分布、但通过预注册重新配对真正破坏二者时间对应关系且不给出任何可恢复 absolute time/version ID 的 falsifier 下性能下降，并且 inference-time transition-prior ablation 也造成独立下降，才能把优势归因于冻结 transition structure。
changed_assumption.en: The chronological-state claim cannot be identified by a simple sequence shuffle that still exposes absolute timestamps. The final assumption requires performance to degrade under a preregistered falsifier that preserves the marginal fingerprint and interval distributions while truly destroying their temporal correspondence and exposing no recoverable absolute time or version ID, and also requires an independent degradation when the transition prior is ablated at inference without retraining.

exact_mechanism.zh: 主模型保持 z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t)，z_t=z_t^-+K_phi(z_t^-,o_t)(o_t-H_psi(z_t^-))，r_hat(a,t)=C_omega(d_a,z_t)，所有参数仅在历史 evaluator 上训练后冻结。为避免 falsifier 泄漏，主比较与 corruption test 统一不输入 absolute timestamps 或可排序的 version IDs，只输入 ordered fingerprints 与相邻 transition intervals Delta t。对每个 rolling-origin evaluation window，在模型比较前固定一个 seed 与 derangement pi，将历史 fingerprint o_i 与另一 chronological slot 的 Delta t_pi(i) 重新配对，保持 fingerprint multiset 与 interval multiset 完全不变，同时破坏其真实对应关系；当前 unseen evaluator fingerprint 保持不变。state model 与 capacity-matched direct-history predictor 接收完全相同的 clean 或 corrupted sequences。另加无需 retraining 的 transition-prior intervention：在冻结参数下将每一步 z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t) 替换为 z_t^-=z_{t-1}，其余 observation update 与 correction head 完全不变。
exact_mechanism.en: Keep the state model z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t), z_t=z_t^-+K_phi(z_t^-,o_t)(o_t-H_psi(z_t^-)), and r_hat(a,t)=C_omega(d_a,z_t), with all parameters trained only on historical evaluators and then frozen. To prevent falsifier leakage, neither the primary comparison nor the corruption test exposes absolute timestamps or sortable version IDs; models receive only ordered fingerprints and adjacent transition intervals Delta t. For each rolling-origin evaluation window, freeze a seed and derangement pi before model comparison, re-pair each historical fingerprint o_i with the transition interval from another chronological slot Delta t_pi(i), preserving the fingerprint multiset and interval multiset exactly while destroying their true correspondence; the current unseen-evaluator fingerprint remains fixed. The state model and capacity-matched direct-history predictor receive exactly the same clean or corrupted sequences. Add a no-retraining transition-prior intervention by replacing z_t^-=T_theta(z_{t-1},Delta t_t) with z_t^-=z_{t-1} at inference while leaving the observation update and correction head unchanged.

children.update_surface: frozen longitudinal evaluator-state transition, observation filter, and actor-specific correction head

learning_signal.zh: state model 与 direct-history baseline 使用完全相同的历史 actor×evaluator residual supervision、fingerprints、transition intervals、actor descriptors、training windows、calls、tokens 和 optimization budget；future evaluator 不提供任何人工或任务标签。corruption 与 transition-prior ablation 均只发生在冻结模型的 evaluation path 中。
learning_signal.en: The state model and direct-history baseline use exactly the same historical actor-by-evaluator residual supervision, fingerprints, transition intervals, actor descriptors, training windows, calls, tokens, and optimization budget. No human or task label from a future evaluator is available. Both the correspondence corruption and transition-prior ablation operate only on the evaluation path of frozen models.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 每个 future evaluator 的 actor-specific bias truth 由完全留出的 actor×evaluator judgments 与任务结果计算，仅在最终 scoring 时揭示；这些 labels 不参与 fingerprint、T/K/H/C、direct predictor、permutation seed 或 corruption construction。
independent_ground_truth.en: Actor-specific bias truth for each future evaluator is computed from fully held-out actor-by-evaluator judgments and task outcomes revealed only for final scoring. These labels are never used by the fingerprints, T/K/H/C modules, direct predictor, permutation seed, or corruption construction.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量与计算匹配的 history-aware direct residual predictor D，获得与 state model 完全相同的 ordered historical fingerprints、current fingerprint、transition intervals、actor descriptors、historical residual labels、calls 和 inference tokens，并在 falsifier 中接受完全相同的 fingerprint-interval derangement；另保留 current-fingerprint-only 与 last-version predictor 作为弱 controls。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity- and compute-matched history-aware direct residual predictor D receiving exactly the same ordered historical fingerprints, current fingerprint, transition intervals, actor descriptors, historical residual labels, calls, and inference tokens as the state model, and receiving the identical fingerprint-interval derangement in the falsifier. Current-fingerprint-only and last-version predictors remain as weaker controls.

decisive_pilot.zh: 预注册三路 rolling-origin test：Clean、Correspondence-Destroyed、Transition-Prior-Ablated。Correspondence-Destroyed 使用固定 derangement，把 fingerprint 与 Delta t 重新配对且彻底删除 absolute timestamp/version identity；同一个 corrupted input 同时送给 state 与 direct-history baseline。识别要求不是简单看到 corruption 后性能变差，而是 clean state model 在 zero-anchor future evaluators 上优于 direct-history baseline，且 state model 的优势在 correspondence destruction 后显著收缩，同时 inference-only 去掉 T_theta prior 也使其 actor-specific residual correction 恶化。若 direct baseline 对同一 corruption 同幅下降，则不能把该变化单独归因于 latent transition。
decisive_pilot.en: Preregister three rolling-origin tests: Clean, Correspondence-Destroyed, and Transition-Prior-Ablated. Correspondence-Destroyed uses the frozen derangement to re-pair fingerprints and Delta t values while removing all absolute timestamps and version identities; the identical corrupted input is supplied to both the state model and direct-history baseline. Identification requires more than a generic corruption drop: the clean state model must outperform the direct-history baseline on zero-anchor future evaluators, that state-model advantage must contract when temporal correspondence is destroyed, and independently removing the T_theta prior only at inference must worsen actor-specific residual correction. If the direct baseline degrades by the same amount under the identical corruption, that drop alone is not attributed to the latent transition.

stop_condition.zh: 若删除所有可恢复时间标识并真正破坏 fingerprint-interval correspondence 后，state model 仍无变化；或 inference-only transition-prior ablation 不降低性能；或 clean state model 在容量/计算匹配 direct-history predictor 上没有稳定优势，则停止“chronological latent transition 是必要机制”的主张。若 corruption 对两种模型产生相同退化而无 state-specific interaction，也不得用该 falsifier 支持主张。
stop_condition.en: Stop the claim that the chronological latent transition is necessary if the state model is unchanged after all recoverable time identifiers are removed and fingerprint-interval correspondence is genuinely destroyed, if inference-only transition-prior ablation does not reduce performance, or if the clean state model has no stable advantage over the capacity/compute-matched direct-history predictor. A corruption that degrades both models equally without a state-specific interaction also cannot support the mechanism claim.

material_change.zh: v5.3 将原先可从 timestamp 恢复 chronology 的 permutation 替换为无 absolute-time 泄漏、保持双方边际但破坏真实 fingerprint-time correspondence 的预注册 falsifier，并对 state 与 direct baseline 使用完全同一 corruption；同时增加冻结模型上的 inference-only transition-prior ablation。因而 chronology 与 transition prior 现在具有可单独证伪的识别路径。
material_change.en: v5.3 replaces the timestamp-recoverable permutation with a preregistered falsifier that exposes no absolute-time leakage, preserves both marginals, and destroys true fingerprint-time correspondence, using exactly the same corruption for the state and direct baselines. It also adds an inference-only transition-prior ablation on the frozen model. Chronology and the transition prior therefore obtain independently falsifiable identification paths.

title.zh: 冻结式可组合角色契约子句库

changed_assumption.zh: 关系级 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM factorization 不能再仅与 whole-task FSM generator 比较。最终假设改为：即使一个最接近的 modular baseline 也从完全相同 traces 中获得可跨任务复用的 executable motif programs，并具有同等 applicability、transition/effect、termination、typed I/O/handoff metadata、router、composer、executor、容量和零 target update，进一步把契约拆成独立 relation clauses 仍能提高 held-out recompositional transfer，才说明 clause factorization 本身有贡献。
changed_assumption.en: Relation-level PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM factorization can no longer be compared only with a whole-task FSM generator. The final assumption is that clause factorization contributes only if it improves held-out recompositional transfer even against the closest modular baseline, which learns reusable executable motif programs from the identical traces and receives equal applicability, transition/effect, termination, typed I/O/handoff metadata, router, composer, executor, capacity, and zero target updates.

exact_mechanism.zh: proposed path 保持原 frozen clause library：只有在至少两个训练任务族以相同 semantic interface 重复出现的 PRE、TRANS、HANDOFF、TERM relation 才获得 versioned clause ID 并进入冻结库；test-time motif router 只能选择训练期 motif，deterministic schema matching 只能组合已冻结 clauses，禁止生成新 clause/state/transition。新增 closest modular control 从完全相同的训练 traces 与 schemas 中学习或抽取 frozen executable motif programs；每个 program 显式携带 applicability/precondition、内部 transition/effect、termination 以及 typed input/output/handoff metadata，并能跨任务复用。它使用与 proposed method 完全相同的 motif router、schema matcher、external executor、training examples、permissions、calls、tokens 与零 target update；一个容量匹配 constrained composer 只能选取和连接这些 frozen programs，不能访问 relation-level clause IDs。两条路径预注册匹配总存储/参数预算、最大 executable states、最大 transitions、composer depth、候选检索数和 inference token budget，因此差异只剩 relation-level factorization versus reusable whole-motif executable programs。
exact_mechanism.en: The proposed path retains the frozen clause library: only PRE, TRANS, HANDOFF, and TERM relations recurring with the same semantic interface in at least two training task families receive versioned clause IDs and enter the frozen library. At test time, the motif router may select only training-time motifs and deterministic schema matching may compose only frozen clauses; generating a new clause, state, or transition is forbidden. Add the closest modular control by learning or extracting frozen executable motif programs from the exact same training traces and schemas. Every program explicitly carries applicability/precondition, internal transition/effect, termination, and typed input/output/handoff metadata and is reusable across tasks. It uses the exact same motif router, schema matcher, external executor, training examples, permissions, calls, tokens, and zero target updates as the proposed method; a capacity-matched constrained composer may only select and connect those frozen programs and cannot access relation-level clause IDs. The two paths preregister matched total storage/parameter budget, maximum executable states, maximum transitions, composer depth, candidate retrieval count, and inference-token budget, leaving relation-level factorization versus reusable whole-motif executable programs as the sole mechanism difference.

children.update_surface: frozen versioned role-contract clause library composed without target-task updates

learning_signal.zh: clause library 与 executable-program library 从完全相同的训练 trajectories、tool schemas、role/handoff observations、success/failure outcomes 与 executor feedback 中抽取；任何 PRE/effect/termination/handoff evidence 都同时允许 program baseline 使用。两者具有相同训练 calls、tokens、优化预算与跨任务复用机会，held-out task 不允许梯度、memory write 或新增 library member。
learning_signal.en: The clause library and executable-program library are extracted from exactly the same training trajectories, tool schemas, role/handoff observations, success/failure outcomes, and executor feedback. Any evidence used to infer PRE, effects, termination, or handoffs is equally available to the program baseline. Both receive the same training calls, tokens, optimization budget, and cross-task reuse opportunities, and held-out tasks permit no gradient, memory write, or new library member.

independent_ground_truth.zh: truth 由训练不可见的 executable assertions 判定：hidden precondition satisfaction、state-transition effects、handoff schema/value assertions、termination correctness、权限约束及端到端任务完成。versioned clause IDs、motif program IDs、router outputs 与训练 executor feedback 均不是 ground truth。
independent_ground_truth.en: Truth is determined by hidden executable assertions unavailable during training: precondition satisfaction, state-transition effects, handoff schema/value assertions, termination correctness, permission constraints, and end-to-end task completion. Versioned clause IDs, motif-program IDs, router outputs, and training executor feedback are not ground truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: 同 traces 学到的 reusable executable-motif/program library：每个 frozen program 都拥有与 proposed clauses 可获得的同等 applicability/precondition、transition/effect、termination 和 typed handoff metadata；相同 motif router、schemas、executor、state/transition limits、composer capacity、calls、tokens、storage budget 与零 target updates 用于 held-out task composition，但 program 内部关系保持整体封装，不拆成独立 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM clause。
simplest_baseline.en: A reusable executable-motif/program library learned from the same traces, where every frozen program has the same available applicability/precondition, transition/effect, termination, and typed handoff metadata as the proposed clauses. The same motif router, schemas, executor, state/transition limits, composer capacity, calls, tokens, storage budget, and zero target updates are used for held-out task composition, but relations inside each program remain encapsulated rather than factorized into independently reusable PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM clauses.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在模型比较前，仅根据 frozen training libraries 的结构预注册两个 held-out strata。Program-sufficient stratum 中存在可直接组合的完整 frozen motif programs；Relation-recombination stratum 中每个所需 PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM relation 都已在至少两个训练任务族独立出现，但没有单个 frozen motif program 包含目标任务所需的完整 relation conjunction。两种方法在完全相同 tasks、router outputs、schemas、executor、state/transition budget 与 inference budget 下零更新执行。关键 falsifier 是：在 program-sufficient stratum 应接近 parity，而在 relation-recombination stratum，只有 clause method 在 hidden handoff/transition assertions 与 end-to-end success 上稳定超过 modular program composer，才能把 transfer gain 归因于 finer relation factorization；若 program composer 同样重组成功，则 clause novelty 被否证。
decisive_pilot.en: Before model comparison, preregister two held-out strata using only the structure of the frozen training libraries. In the Program-Sufficient stratum, complete frozen motif programs exist that can be directly composed. In the Relation-Recombination stratum, every required PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM relation has independently occurred in at least two training task families, but no single frozen motif program contains the complete relation conjunction required by the target task. Both methods execute with zero updates on the identical tasks, router outputs, schemas, executor, state/transition budget, and inference budget. The key falsifier is that the methods should approach parity on Program-Sufficient tasks, while the clause method may claim finer-factorization transfer only if it reliably exceeds the modular program composer on hidden handoff/transition assertions and end-to-end success in Relation-Recombination tasks. If the program composer recombines successfully as well, the clause novelty is falsified.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量、数据、metadata、跨任务复用机会、composer、executor 与零更新条件全部对齐后，reusable executable-program baseline 在预注册 relation-recombination tasks 上匹配 clause library，则停止“PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM 关系级分解带来额外迁移能力”的主张，并将该方法视为 executable-skill/contract composition 的一种表示形式。若优势仅来自更大 library、更多 states/transitions、额外 handoff labels 或更高 inference budget，同样停止。
stop_condition.en: If, after equalizing capacity, data, metadata, cross-task reuse opportunity, composer, executor, and zero-update conditions, the reusable executable-program baseline matches the clause library on preregistered Relation-Recombination tasks, stop the claim that PRE/TRANS/HANDOFF/TERM relation-level decomposition adds transfer capability and treat the method as a representation variant of executable-skill/contract composition. Also stop if any advantage is attributable to a larger library, more states/transitions, extra handoff labels, or a larger inference budget.

material_change.zh: v5.3 增加的不是弱 whole-FSM control，而是文献碰撞后真正最接近的同数据 modular executable-program baseline，并把其 applicability、effects、termination、handoff metadata、router、composer、executor、reuse、capacity 与 zero-update 条件全部对齐。预注册 program-sufficient × relation-recombination 分层进一步直接检验 finer clause factorization 是否在 reusable executable skills 之上提供独立 transfer。
material_change.en: v5.3 adds not another weak whole-FSM control but the genuinely closest same-data modular executable-program baseline exposed by the collision search, equalizing applicability, effects, termination, handoff metadata, router, composer, executor, reuse, capacity, and zero-update conditions. The preregistered Program-Sufficient versus Relation-Recombination stratification then directly tests whether finer clause factorization provides independent transfer beyond reusable executable skills.
